They typecheck only by unfolding the `def`s `delta` and `tMom`; no step in the proof shows that bridge, and the neighbouring tactic proofs (e.g. `minkowskiProduct_avgMomentum_self_eq`, line 158) do go through `tMom_def, delta_def`.

findings.evidence: Lines 394-402; grep for `causallyFollows` across `code/EpsilonEridani` returns only this file, so no such lemma exists yet, and Physlib has only `causallyFollows_zero_iff` (0 ≤ timeComponent) in `Physlib/Relativity/Causality/CausallyFollows.lean:63`.
findings.fix: Extract `0 < ⟪x,x⟫ₘ → causallyFollows 0 x → 0 < x.timeComponent` as a lemma in `Relativity/Tensors/RealTensor/Vector/MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean` (it is the `minkowskiProduct_self_le_timeComponent_sq` + `nlinarith` step), and let `hpos` reduce to `PoincareGroup.causallyFollows_zero_smul` plus `minkowskiProduct_invariant`.
findings.issue: `exists_isBreitFrame` inlines `have hpos : ∀ x, causallyFollows 0 x → ⟪x,x⟫ₘ = T.mass ^ 2 → 0 < (Λ • x).timeComponent`, whose content has nothing to do with the target: a future-directed vector of positive Minkowski square has positive time component, and the time component is Lorentz-invariant in sign under an orthochronous `Λ`.

summary: Six pairing lemmas are proved by term application of generic `v - u` lemmas, matching only by definitional unfolding of `delta`/`tMom` and bypassing the files' own `delta_def`/`tMom_def` (a bridge the GPD versions had before this PR). `exists_isBreitFrame` also inlines a general, reusable Lorentz fact as a local `have`.
